source.architecture_title: G4.5 Programmable Brush System Architecture v0.1
source.implementation_plan_title: G4.5 Programmable Brush System Foundation Implementation Plan v0.1

semantic_invariants: BrushDefinition is an authoring/runtime model and is not a SemanticDocument canonical object by default
BrushProgram is immutable, versioned, renderer-neutral internal IR and is not a shader, Skia Paint, GPU object, or canonical state
BrushRuntime is the single semantic evaluator and produces separate commit and preview artifacts
Arc consumes render-ready primitives, material and resource bindings without interpreting brush semantics
Canonical StrokeRecord remains BrushDescriptor plus deterministic_seed plus VectorStrokeData or DabStrokeData
FinePen, Highlighter and TexturedMarker historical replay and golden behavior remain unchanged
Laser is TemporalTransient and performs zero canonical mutation
Platform capability differences are explicit profile data and must not silently change semantics
open_or_deferred: true wet-mix or canvas-read pigment semantics
G5 tile, cache, scheduler and resource-budget work
